Preserve master mix and unmute volume; all assertion statements in this witness are required.

mappings.why: ScrivCLIAudioImport validates an owned synthetic WAV and awaits importAudio. Default import group invokes selected-dialogue then scene-silence import after playhead 3500. verifyImportedAsset checks measured asset and bytes; expectedClip checks placement and clipping to available scene time; mutation checks complete project preservation and one revision. Passing preconditions and stable navigation only. Invalid front-door payloads never witness WorkspaceStore guard failures; picker, security-scope grant, decoder failure and navigation races excluded.
